classification_definitions.A: Direct merge candidate after current exact-head checks and independent review
classification_definitions.B: Useful isolated candidate requiring current integration repair/requalification
classification_definitions.C: Selective extraction or unresolved branch envelope
classification_definitions.D: Exact ancestor or demonstrated complete material content

limitations: No branch was deleted, tagged, closed or merged by this audit.
No fresh test run was needed for history disposition; source content, ancestry, patches, and hosted check metadata were inspected.
Missing paths identify absent source artifacts; renamed implementations may cover part of their behavior, so they are not proof that every associated end-user behavior is absent.
Old head CI does not qualify a newly merged tree.
PR-own-delta metrics use merge-base(PR recorded base, head); cumulative branch backlog is classified separately.
